title: 第15章 大智若愚？-《全民饥荒：SSS级天赋酿酒师》
content:
第(1/3)页

    就在许默看得有些出神之际，脑海中突然毫无征兆地刺痛起来！

    “嘶——”

    连接蚁后的精神丝线上，猛地传来一阵惊悚的受伤感知！

    那是几只负责在外围警戒的黑蚁，在同一时间被某种未知的恐怖力量瞬间碾碎前，传回来的感知变成剧痛.

    许默的瞳孔骤然收缩，心脏猛地漏跳了一拍。

    【系统提示：情绪产生剧烈波动，理智值-5！】

    刚刚才在壁炉火光下稳住的理智条，竟硬生生往下跌了一截。

    许默万万没想到，蚂蚁的情绪竟然影响了他的理智。

    他立刻下令，让所有外出探索的蚂蚁全都以安全为第一位，夜间不要离开巢穴。

    就在这时，恐怖的提示出现。

    【天黑了，请闭眼。】

    许默迅速扫向右上角的时间面板。

    原本显示着距离入夜的倒计时已经彻底消失，换了一排字符。

    【距离天亮还有：09:55:59】

    也就是在这一刻，系统聊天公屏开始变得热闹起来。

    压抑到极致的恐慌，终于化作了无数条疯狂滚动的文字。

    【李珊：救命！救命啊！我完蛋了！门外有东西在疯狂砸门！我的庇护所耐久度一直在往下掉！我该怎么办？！谁来救救我！】

    【苏明：为什么系统给的壁炉不能自动点火？！我没有砍到木头！没有木头啊！周围全是黑的，一点光都没有，我感觉有什么东西就贴着我的后脖颈在喘气！它在摸我的脸！！】

    伴随着一条条绝望的求救信息，许默死死盯着频道右上角的存活人数。

    数字正在不断的跳跃闪烁，数量以令人头皮发麻的速度往下狂跌。

    计数的每一次闪烁，都意味着一条鲜活生命的消亡。

    就在公屏已经彻底陷入癫狂的当口。

    【杨军：所有人注意！立刻停止无意义的恐慌！】

    【1.黑暗地带会出现“迷雾怪”，它们就是黑夜里的杀手！】

    【2.迷雾怪会无差别攻击玩家和庇护所，唯一的克制方法是用火焰驱散！必须保证火源不灭！】

    【3.恐惧、尖叫等任何情绪波动都会成倍消耗理智！减少消耗的最佳方式是睡觉！如果实在害怕睡不着，就想办法把自己弄晕！】

    【4.庇护所耐久掉落到0，建筑会直接判定为废墟，所有保护效果立刻移除，夜晚必死无疑！】

    许默盯着这四条情报，眼底闪过忌惮。

    这一条条，都是应验过的？
    第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

Just when Xu Mo was looking a little lost in thought, his mind suddenly started to tingle without any warning!

"Hiss——"

A frightening feeling of injury suddenly coming from the mental thread connecting the Queen Ant!

Those were a few black ants responsible for guarding the perimeter. Before they were instantly crushed by some unknown terrifying force at the same time, the sensation they sent back turned into severe pain.

Xu Mo’s pupils suddenly shrank and his heart skipped a beat.

【System prompt: Severe mood swings, sanity value -5!】

The sanity bar that had just been stabilized under the firelight of the fireplace suddenly dropped.

Xu Mo never expected that Ant's emotions would affect his reason.

He immediately ordered that all ants who went out to explore should put safety first and not leave the nest at night.

At this moment, a terrifying reminder appeared.

【It’s dark, please close your eyes.】

Xu Mo quickly scanned the time panel in the upper right corner.

The countdown that originally showed the time until nightfall has completely disappeared, and a row of characters has been replaced.

【There is still time until dawn: 09:55:59】

It was at this moment that the system chat screen began to become lively.

The panic that was suppressed to the extreme finally turned into countless text scrolling crazily.

【Li Shan: Help!Help!I'm done!Something is banging on the door!The durability of my shelter keeps going down!what do I do?!Someone come and save me!】

[Su Ming: Why can’t the fireplace provided by the system ignite automatically?!I didn't cut any wood!There is no wood!The surroundings were all dark, there was no light at all, and I felt like something was breathing against the back of my neck!It's touching my face!!】

Along with the desperate messages for help, Xu Mo stared at the number of survivors in the upper right corner of the channel.

The numbers are constantly jumping and flashing, and the number is plummeting at a mind-numbing speed.

Every flash of the count means the death of a living life.

Just when Gongping had completely fallen into madness.

【Yang Jun: Attention, everyone!Stop the senseless panic now!】

【1. "Mist monsters" will appear in dark areas, they are killers in the night!】

【2. The fog monster will attack players and shelters indiscriminately, and the only way to restrain it is to use fire to disperse it!It is necessary to ensure that the source of fire is not extinguished!】

【3. Any emotional fluctuations such as fear and screaming will double the consumption of sanity!The best way to reduce consumption is to sleep!If you are really afraid of not being able to sleep, try to knock yourself out!】

【4. When the durability of the shelter drops to 0, the building will be directly judged as a ruin, all protective effects will be removed immediately, and you will definitely die at night!】

Xu Mo stared at these four pieces of information, fear flashing in his eyes.
